contexts.text: The sons of Javan () = others still who had external worship derived from the worship which prevailed with the nation Javan; Elishah, Tarshish, Chittim and Dodanim were so many nations with whom there was such worship, and by which also are signified so many doctrinals, which were rituals, derived from the external worship with Javan. AC 1156.
The beam of a ship from the isles of Chittim () = externals of worship, thus rituals which relate to the class of celestial things.
(Chittim is called the isles from external worship.)
The isles of Chittim () = those who are more remote from worship, that is, the gentiles who are in simple good, and thence in natural truth.
By the land of Chittim () is meant what is idolatrous.
The isles of Chittim = where they are who live naturally in truths.
